title: Hook Execution Planning and Matching
body: Implement hook matching logic and execution planning with support for tool matchers, deduplication, and sequential vs parallel execution modes.

linked_prs.title: feat(hooks): Hook Execution Planning and Matching
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

Creates HookPlanner that matches hooks to events using exact/regex/wildcard patterns, deduplicates identical hooks, and creates optimized execution plans.
[Part of full hook system implementation here](https://github.com/Edilmo/gemini-cli/pull/7/files)

## Dive Deeper

This component implements the matching logic described in the design document. It supports exact string matching, regex patterns, and wildcard matching for tool names using the tool's displayName. The planner deduplicates identical command hooks and plugin methods to avoid redundant execution. It creates execution plans that specify whether hooks should run sequentially (with input modification) or in parallel for performance.

## Reviewer Test Plan

- Test exact tool name matching (e.g., "WriteFile")
- Test regex pattern matching (e.g., "Edit|Write|Read")
- Test wildcard matching ("*" matches all tools)
- Verify hook deduplication works correctly
- Test sequential vs parallel execution planning
